definition: words or speech that fills another with an assurance, comfort or solace; comforting assurance.
example: ಅವನ ದಿಲ್ಭರವಸಾ ಮಾತುಗಳು ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಧಾನ ತಂದವು.
example_en: His comforting, assuring words brought her solace.

definition: a woman with her head completely shaven.
example_en: That shaven-headed woman lived in the hermitage in grief.

definition: an act or course of digging.
example_en: The digging for the well continued for two days.

definition: the relation between an object and its image in a mirror.
example_en: The teacher explained the relation between an object and its mirror-image through an example.

definition: the early part of the day; morning.
example_en: The cool breeze of the early morning gave delight to the mind.

definition: to convert a liquid or solid to gaseous state.
example_en: Scientists conducted an experiment to convert the liquid into gas.

definition: to cause to pour.
example_en: The clouds caused heavy rain to pour down.

definition: containing, smeared with, having fragrance, perfume, etc.
example_en: The prayer room was filled with fragrance.

definition: the persons previously mentioned or being referred to from a distance.
example_en: They came to the town yesterday.

definition: having a family.
example_en: He came to the village for the festival along with his family.

definition: the tree Shorea talura ( = S. robusta, = Vatica robusta) of Dipterocarpaceae family.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಬಡಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಕಲಿಯಲು ಕಸಬುಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿದನು.
example_en: That boy joined a vocational school to learn carpentry.

definition: to pour a molten material into a mould to give a shape; to cast; to mould.
example_en: The blacksmith cast the iron into a shape.

definition: the quality of charming or pleasing to look at; beauty; charm; loveliness.
example_en: The charm of the new bride attracted everyone's heart.

definition: a kind of flat, buoyant structure of logs, boards, barrels, etc. fastened together.
example_en: They built a raft at the bank of the stream and crossed over.

definition: serving or tending to connect; connective.
example: ಈ ಎರಡು ಭಾಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಪದ ಬೇಕು.
example_en: These two parts need a connecting word.

definition: one's companion;
example_en: He is my soul companion.

definition: something seen; view; sight.
example_en: The view of the town from the hilltop was beautiful.

definition: to rend another's heart.
example_en: That news rent her heart.

definition: a lustful desire to look at.
example: ಅವನ ಕಣ್ತೀಟೆ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕೆಟ್ಟ ದಾರಿಗೆ ಎಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His lustful desire to look led him down a bad path.

definition: agony; torture; anguish; affliction.
example_en: The agony showed clearly on the patient's face.

definition: a food baked from a leavened, kneaded dough made with flour or meal, water, etc.; bread.
example_en: They offered bread to the god in the temple.

definition: a man who delivers mail; a postman.
example_en: The postman brings letters every morning.

definition: the state or practice of having two or more husbands at the same time; plural marriage; polygamy.
example_en: Polygamy is still practised in that tribe.

definition: near in position; close together; approximate.
example: ಶಾಲೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಸುಮಾರು ಒಂದು ಮೈಲಿ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.
example_en: The school is approximately one mile away from here.

definition: a kind of insect.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಅರುಗ ಎಂಬ ಕೀಟ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: An insect called aruga appeared under the old tree.

definition: a going back or backward movement.
example_en: A backward movement was seen in his talk.

definition: (collectively) all the (eight) directions.
example: ದೇವರ ಶಕ್ತಿ ದಿಗುಮಂಡಲದಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಾ ಹರಡಿದೆ ಎಂದು ನಂಬಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They believed that God's power spread across all the directions.

definition: a rope having a noose at one end.
example_en: The honey collector was holding the noosed rope in his hand.

definition: a paste made of sulphur.
example_en: The doctor advised applying sulphur paste for the skin disease.

definition: the hollow, muscular organ in a humans that pumps and maintains circulation of the blood in the body; the heart.
example: ಓಟದ ನಂತರ ಅವನ ಎದೆಗುಂಡಿಗೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಬಡಿಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the run, his heart was beating fast.

definition: the state revenue collected by way of fines imposed as punishments.
example_en: The government collected fine revenue from the offenders.

definition: a sound.
example_en: The sound of the river's water fell on the ears.

definition: the quality of being lusterous; lustre; brilliance.
example_en: The brilliance of the water shone in the sunlight.

definition: a worker in a skilled trade; craftsman; an artisan.
example: ಆ ಕೈಕೆಲಸಗಾರ ಮರದಿಂದ ಸುಂದರ ಬೊಂಬೆ ಕೆತ್ತಿದನು.
example_en: That artisan carved a beautiful doll from wood.

definition: the state or fact of coming out of sleep, stupor, trance etc.; the state of being or staying awake.
example_en: His waking up happened quickly.

definition: a tax levied on people travelling by air, ship, etc.
example_en: The travellers paid the border tax at the airport.

definition: the slender stalk by which a fruit or leaf is attached to the plant; a stalk.
example_en: The stalk of the mango was sturdy.

definition: to have the problem of indigestion.
example_en: He suffered from indigestion because of the heavy meal.

definition: of, belonging to or concerning a particular person.
example: ಇದು ಅವನ ಕಾಸಾ ವಿಚಾರ, ಬೇರೆಯವರಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧವಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: This is his personal matter; it has nothing to do with others.

definition: a variety in boa.
example_en: That variety of boa grows very long.

definition: a sudden, sharp pain caused by involuntary contraction of a muscle or muscles from chill, strain, etc.; cramp.
example_en: A cramp came in the leg from the long walk.

definition: the plant Trachyspermum ammi ( = Carum cpiticum) of Apiaceae family; Bishop's weed.
example_en: If bishop's weed is added to the curry, the taste improves.

definition: to collapse - a) to break down or fail suddenly in health or physical strength; b) to fall down, as from a blow or exhaustion c) to fall or drop drastically, as in value or force.
example_en: He suddenly collapsed from exhaustion.

definition: a pole on which a flag is raised and flown; a flag-pole.
example_en: The flag-pole was erected atop the fort.

definition: a useless person.
example_en: He is a useless person, no good for any work.

definition: requiring careful consideration or thought; involving difficulty, effort or considered action; serious; severe.
example_en: His health condition was serious.

definition: various; miscellaneous; petty (as expenses).
example_en: There were many miscellaneous expenses.

definition: a violent physical attack.
example_en: A violent physical attack was carried out on him on the street.

definition: a village or town.
example_en: That village is on the bank of the river.

definition: a handful of food.
example: ಹಸಿದ ಬಡವನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಒರ್ತುತ್ತು ಅನ್ನ ಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: She gave a handful of food to the hungry poor man.

definition: a man who enters into or being rivalry; a contender; a competitor.
example_en: That competitor struggled hard to win the contest.

definition: an eclipse in which one celestial body is partially obscured by the shadow or body of another; a partial eclipse.
example: ಅಪೂರ್ಣ ಗ್ರಹಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಂದ್ರನ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮರೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: In the partial eclipse, only a part of the moon was obscured.

definition: carefully thought out and formed or done on purpose; premeditated; deliberately.
example_en: She took that decision deliberately, after due thought.

definition: the act of going up or above.
example_en: A gradual upward progress appeared in his life.

definition: to recite (a prayer); to pray.
example_en: The devotees prayed in the temple.

definition: originated, made or produced long back.
example: ಪೞೆಯ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The village people still follow the old, ancient practices.

definition: a piece of square or rectangular cloth used for wiping; a towel.
example_en: She used a towel to wipe the vessels in the kitchen.

definition: not the same; distinct; separate; other; different.
example_en: This colour is different from his colour.

definition: a man on the duty of watching at a small opening of a fort.
example_en: The gate-watchman stood guard at the fort's opening.

definition: a device for measuring mechanical force, as a balance; a dynamometre.
example_en: The engineer measured the tension of the rope with a dynamometer.

definition: to become wider or broader; to increase one's vastness.
example_en: The news of the town quickly spread wider.

definition: great power; heavy influence.
example_en: Everyone knew of that minister's great influence.

definition: that which is smeared with ash.
example: ಸಾಧು ಬೂದಿಬುಕ್ಕ ಮೈಯಿಂದ ಗುಡಿಸಲ ಮುಂದೆ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The ash-smeared ascetic sat in front of the hut.

definition: (dial.) the eighth month in the Hindu calendar.
example_en: There is festive excitement in the month of koḍi.

definition: to scatter things here and there; to strew in a disorderly manner.
example_en: The rainwater scattered the flowers as it flowed.

definition: stubborn refusal to submit or yield oneself to; contumacy; stubbornness.
example_en: His stubborn obstinacy annoyed the teacher.

definition: the transfer of heat by its absorption by a fluid at one point followed by motion of the fluid and rejection of the heat at another point; convection.
example: ಒಲೆಯ ಉಷ್ಣತೆ ಉಷ್ಣನಯನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಕೋಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The stove's heat spread through the room by convection.

definition: to make ready; to prepare; to make receptive; dispose; accustom; to equip or furnish with necessary provisions, accessories, etc.
example_en: The teacher prepared the students for the examination.

definition: the state of being crowded.
example: ಜಾತ್ರೆಯ ದಿನ ಬಜಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳ ಸಂದಣಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a great crowd in the market on the fair day.

definition: greatness; eminence; superiority; distinction.
example_en: Everyone knew of that scholar's greatness.

definition: the act of coercing; use of force or intimidation to obtain compliance; coercion.
example_en: They used force to open the door.

definition: a man who works, esp. in a laborious, strenuous job; a toiler.
example_en: That toiler works day and night.

definition: a conference of people of any profession.
example_en: A conference of doctors was held in the city.

definition: a small hill; a mound; a hillock.
example_en: The children played on the small hillock.

definition: (a plant) to put forth new leaves luxuriantly.
example_en: In the rainy season, trees put forth new leaves luxuriantly.

definition: the act, process or fact of decomposing; putrefaction.
example_en: A bad smell was coming from the decomposed fruits.

definition: that which is accurate or exact.
example_en: The account he gave was exact.

definition: the service or profession of a medical doctor.
example: ಅವನು ಬೆಜ್ಜು ಕಲಿತು ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೈದ್ಯ ಸೇವೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: He learned medicine and practised as a doctor in the village.

definition: toward inside.
example_en: She opened the window so the breeze would come toward inside.

definition: a man not worthy of trust; an undependable, unreliable man.
example_en: Do not entrust any work to an unreliable man.

definition: a developing or being developed.
example: ಈ ಮಗುವಿನ ಬೆಳೆವಳಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: This child's development is progressing very well.

definition: the upper garment of woman, covering the shoulders, back and breasts; a blouse.
example_en: She chose a blouse that matched her saree.

definition: a folded part; a fold; a layer.
example_en: He folded and kept one layer of cloth.

definition: (a god, deity, etc.) to take the offerings.
example_en: The deity took the offerings of the devotees.

definition: wood used as fuel; fire-wood.
example_en: They brought firewood from the forest for cooking.

definition: not set up by human; not of the authorship of man; of divine origin.
example_en: The Vedas are considered to be of divine, not human, origin.

definition: the entrance of a building; a door.
example_en: The palace's entrance door was decorated with gold.

definition: an opening in or through anything; a break; a gap; a hole; an aperture.
example_en: A gap appeared in the wall.

definition: a sheet or sheets of paper used as a pad while writing.
example_en: While writing, she placed the writing pad on the table.

definition: a statement expressing grief and dissatisfaction, with a request for justice; a complaint; an appeal.
example_en: The farmer submitted his complaint to the district officer.

definition: the part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist; the forearm.
example_en: His forearm turned dark due to the sun.

definition: a man who describes or gives descriptive representations; a describer.
example_en: The describer of the old poem was famous.

definition: one who is beyond the normal qualities; a man with exceptional qualities that cannot be surpassed.
example: ಆ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿ ತನ್ನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗಣಿತ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆಯುಳ್ಳವನು.
example_en: That scientist is a man of exceptional talent in his field.

definition: to be green or greenish.
example_en: The leaves of the plants turn green in the rainy season.

definition: a government officer who registers and maintains records; a registrar.
example_en: The registrar recorded the land documents.

definition: the state of being straight; the quality of not being free from bent or crooked.
example: ಆ ಕಂಬದ ಅಪ್ರನಮಿತತೆ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್‌ಗೆ ಸಮಾಧಾನ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The straightness of that pillar gave the engineer satisfaction.

definition: without cost of payment; free.
example_en: At school, children are given food for free.

definition: a condition that is causing irritation or annoyance; irritation; an uncomfortable situation.
example: ಆ ಯಂತ್ರದ ಕಿಟಿಪಿಟಿ ಸದ್ದು ಕೆಲಸಗಾರರಿಗೆ ಕಿರಿಕಿರಿ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.

definition: to become disappointed, dejected.
example_en: After losing, the player became dejected.

definition: a single hand.
example_en: He held the door with a single hand.

definition: to rob or despoil (a person or place) by force, as in warfare or on a desolate way; to plunder.
example_en: The soldiers plundered the enemy's village.

definition: a period of seven days; a week.
example_en: He goes to his village every week.

definition: (of time) what (time).
example_en: How much time is needed to come here?

definition: a shower of arows (shot incessantly).
example_en: A shower of arrows poured upon the enemy army.

definition: to have a hollow place in the stem or a branch; to have hole.
example_en: The trunk of the old tree is developing a hollow.

definition: freedom or release from captivity, confinement, slavery, physical restraint or any other form of arbitrary control: liberty.
example_en: The prisoners finally obtained their freedom.

definition: a summary and balance of accounts.
example_en: The clerk prepared the summary and balance of accounts at the year's end.

definition: a rubbing, esp. of one object against another; friction.
example: ಚಕ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಸಂಘರ್ಷಣ ಶಬ್ದ ಮಾಡಿತು.

definition: to make firm; to confirm.
example_en: Everyone together confirmed the resolution of the meeting.

definition: a weapon consisting of a long shaft, with a pointed end, used for throwing at or stabbing; a spear.
example_en: The king's guard stood holding a spear.

definition: the most shining point of a diamond.
example_en: The diamond's shining point glittered in the light.

definition: (pl.) both the feet (of a person).
example_en: They had tied anklets to both of her feet.

definition: a procession of devotees singing devotional songs and hymns.
example_en: The procession of devotees moved toward the temple, singing.

definition: regarded with favour, approval or affection by or appealing to, the people in general.
example: ಆ ನಟ ಇಡೀ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That actor is a popular person throughout the country.

definition: bearing or able to bear; carrying or able to carry.
example_en: That pillar was bearing the load of the roof.

definition: genuine humility.
example_en: Genuine humility was clearly visible in his speech.

definition: a kind of medicinal substance made of pomegranate.
example_en: The doctor prescribed the pomegranate preparation as medicine.

definition: the condition of being husband and wife; matrimony.
example_en: Their matrimony has been happy for thirty years.

definition: a bundle of lies; a false network; a spurious net.
example_en: All his words were like a bundle of lies.

definition: the moment gone by; a moment previous to the present one.
example_en: He smiled, recalling the moments gone by.

definition: (pl.) five hoods (as of mythological serpent).
example_en: The sculptor carved a five-hooded serpent in stone.

definition: the state or quality of being incomplete, imperfect, deficient; incompleteness; imperfection.
example_en: The imperfection of his report was clearly visible.

definition: a living; life.
example_en: The life of the villagers depends on agriculture.

definition: a small, wrapped bundle; a package; a parcel.
example_en: They opened that package carefully.

definition: to place, keep, put in a particular place, condition.
example_en: He placed the book in the cupboard.

definition: a narrow strip of leather, often with a buckle or similar fastener at one end, for binding or securing animals or things; a leather strap.
example_en: A leather strap had been tied to the oxen's legs.

definition: a kind of medicinal substance .

definition: a long bamboo staff.
example_en: He walked holding the long bamboo staff.

definition: a length of one hundred feet.
example: ಆ ಬಾವಿಯ ಆಳ ಸುಮಾರು ನೂರಡಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The depth of that well is about a hundred feet.

definition: an advanced, higher rank, position in a hierarchy.
example_en: That officer's high rank in the court was elevated.

definition: smeared; anointed; besmeared.
example_en: The idol of the god was besmeared with vermilion.

definition: to cause to move, go ahead or away.
example_en: The driver moved the bus ahead.

definition: amounting to twelve.
example: ಈರಾಱು ಜನ ಸೇರಿದರೆ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ತಂಡವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If twelve people gather, it becomes a large group.

definition: a married woman, whose principal occupation is managing a household and taking care of domestic affairs; a house-wife.
example: ಆಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮನೆವೆಣ್ ಆಗಿ ಸಂಸಾರವನ್ನು ನಿಭಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: She is a good housewife who manages the household well.

definition: the maximum limit (either in time or in space).
example_en: His patience had reached its maximum limit.

definition: a man limited in outlook or lacking in tolerance; a prejudiced, mean or narrow-minded fellow.
example: ಬಿನುಗು ಜನರ ಜೊತೆ ವಾದ ಮಾಡಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನವಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: There is no use arguing with narrow-minded people.

definition: fat; corpulent.
example_en: That fat buffalo struggled even to walk.

definition: good disposition or character; moral conduct; piety; virtue.
example_en: His virtuous character was admired by everyone.

definition: to slip or slide (as from anothers' grip or hold).
example: ಕೈಯಿಂದ ಹಗ್ಗ ಜಾಱಾಗಿ ಬುಟ್ಟಿ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The rope slipped from his hand and the basket fell down.

definition: craving for food; wanting, needing food; hungry.
example_en: The hungry child cried and asked for food.

definition: a hospital where animals are treated; a veterinary hospital.
example_en: They took the injured cow to the veterinary hospital.

definition: the act, art or occupation of performing in plays, movies, etc; acting.
example_en: Her acting greatly captivated the audience.

definition: to scorn; to treat contemptuously.
example_en: He scorned and insulted the poor man.

definition: lack of publicity; the state of being not famous.
example_en: That artist's lack of fame saddened him.

definition: to be free from anxiety, nervousness, mental agitation, etc.
example: ಎಲ್ಲ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಳು ಪದುಳಿರಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After all the work was finished, she was able to be free from anxiety.

definition: a short note or letter; a chit.
example_en: He wrote a short note to his friend.

definition: any unclean or soiling matter, as mud, dust, dung, trash, etc.; spoiled or waste food, that is thrown away; rubbish; filth; garbage.
example_en: The workers swept away the filth lying on the street.

definition: special; exceptional; extraordinary.
example_en: This is a special occasion; everyone must gather.

definition: a fish of genus Clarium; clarias.
example_en: Clarias fish are found abundantly in the muddy pond.

definition: Yamunā river, one of the major rivers of North India.

example_en: They say that bathing on the banks of the Yamuna washes away one's sins.

definition: to understand another opinion, feeling, etc.
example_en: He tried to understand his friend's feelings.

definition: a strong, narrow, woven strip of cotton, linen, etc. used to bind seams in garments, tie bundles, etc.; a tape.
example_en: She tied the bundle of clothes with tape.

definition: the colour of ochre; reddish brown.
example_en: The ascetic's robe was of a reddish brown colour.

definition: a very small bit; particle; a speck.
example_en: A thick layer of dust particles had settled on the window.

definition: (dial.) community dinner arranged for Vīraśaiva mendicants.
example_en: A community dinner was arranged for the mendicants at the monastery.

definition: a small roll of opium wrapped in thin paper or a leaf for smoking.
example_en: He was secretly smoking a roll of opium.

definition: the quality or state of being indulgently lenient.
example_en: The grandfather's indulgent leniency spoiled the children.

definition: a kind of typhus disease, accompanied by high fever in which the patient keeps uttering insensible or nonsensical words continuously; typhomania.
example: ಆ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಬಗುಳುಸನ್ನಿಯಿಂದ ಅಸಂಬದ್ಧ ಮಾತುಗಳು ಬರುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: That patient was uttering nonsensical words due to typhomania.

definition: a deity to be worshipped.
example_en: The deity worshipped in that temple is Shiva.

definition: any tailless, stout-bodied amphibian of the order Anura, including the smooth, moist-skinned frog species that live in a damp or semi aquatic habitat and the warty, drier-skinned toad species that are mostly terrestrial as adults; a frog.
example_en: The frog was sitting near the pond.

definition: the consonant 'ch'.
example: ಛತ್ವ ಎಂಬುದು 'ಚ' ಎಂಬ ವ್ಯಂಜನದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಹೆಸರು.
example_en: Chatva is another name for the consonant 'ch'.

definition: one who makes impressions (of pictures on cloth).

example_en: That block-printer produced pictures on the cloth.

definition: the quality or fact of having a sharp rise or highly inclined slope; steepness; precipitousness.

definition: a heavy rain or downpour.

definition: a devastating fire.

definition: simple, but clear (as opp. to gaudy) light.

example_en: The devotees placed the dust of the guru's feet on their heads.

definition: happiness; joy.

definition: the quality or fact of being matchless; matchlessness.

example_en: Everyone knew the matchlessness of that artist's talent.

definition: immediately; at once.
example: ಗಂಟೆ ಬಾರಿಸಿದ ಕೂಡಲೇ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಜುಮ್ಮನೆ ಎದ್ದರು.
example_en: As soon as the bell rang, the children got up at once.

definition: the act or time of commencing; beginning; start; commencement.

definition: an archaic musical instrument.

example_en: The musician played the ancient instrument called nāḍi.

definition: a metal chain or fetters.

definition: a violator of code of religious, social or moral conduct.

definition: a restraint - a) act of restraining; b) a restraining influence or force.

definition: a bad, improper means.

definition: perfect blessedness; the state of being emancipated from all the worldly attachments, agony, etc.

example_en: Mother fried the roti in the pan without oil.

definition: to work as a labour in a garden.

definition: a main road; a highway.

definition: the mother of one's wife; a mother-in-law.
example_en: The mother-in-law taught her daughter-in-law how to cook.

definition: a kind of medicinal substances made using five substances (Chinese pepper, clarified butter, sugar, honey and milk).
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪಸಾರೆ ಎಂಬ ಔಷಧಿ ತಯಾರಿಸಿಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Grandmother prepared the medicine called pasāre for the children.

definition: a kind of grass.
example_en: A kind of grass had spread over the slope of the hill.

definition: a dried up water tank.
example_en: Children were playing in the village's dried-up water tank.

definition: one of the four equal parts of a whole; a quarter.
example: ಅವನು ಜಮೀನಿನ ಒಂದು ಪಾವು ಪಾಲನ್ನು ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: He received a quarter share of the land.

definition: a glass bottle.
example: ಟೇಬಲ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಸೀಸೆ ನೀರು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a bottle of water on the table.

definition: the act of beating; a giving a blow or blows.
example_en: The beating of the drum was heard all night.

definition: the front or top end; tip; apex.
example_en: The tip of the mountain was covered with clouds.

definition: a man engaged in agriculture; an agriculturist; farmer.
example_en: The farmer got up in the morning and went to the paddy field.

definition: to be uneasy, anxious.
example_en: She was uneasy and anxious waiting for the exam results.

definition: thick; stout; fat.
example_en: That man looked thick and stout.

definition: a future event.
example_en: They prayed that the coming future event be good.

definition: anything that hinders the movement of one's legs.
example_en: The creeper became a hindrance to his legs and he fell.

example_en: That wrestler had learned a new hold.

definition: a male baby.
example_en: A healthy male baby was born to her.

definition: a look beautiful.
example_en: The temple tower looks beautiful in the evening light.

definition: to cause to rest against or on something for support; to make (another or something) lean against, recline on.
example_en: He made the baby lean against the pillow.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: They had grown the sihisoḍari plant in the corner of the garden.

definition: a stout nose.
example_en: Everyone recognises him because he has a stout nose.

definition: a man who loves; a lover.
example_en: Her lover used to write a letter every day.

definition: either of the two fleshy parts which in humans and animals form the upper and lower edges of the mouth-opening; the lip.
example: ಚಳಿಯಿಂದ ಅವನ ಒದರು ಒಣಗಿ ಬಿರುಕು ಬಿಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His lip had dried and cracked from the cold.

definition: the details of the farm land or plantation held by a farmer severally.
example_en: They recorded the details of the farmer's severally-held land in the village office.

definition: a collection of sacred Zoroastrian writings, including the Gatha and their translation and exposition; Zend Avesta.
example: ಜೆಂದ್‌ಅವಸ್ತವನ್ನು ಪಾರ್ಸಿ ಧರ್ಮದ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಗ್ರಂಥವೆಂದು ಗೌರವಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The Zend Avesta is revered as the sacred scripture of the Parsi religion.

definition: a division of Dravidian race, who speak Gōṇḍi, in central India.
example_en: The Gonda people speak the Gondi language.

definition: the state of being well cooked, roasted or baked (as food).
example_en: They served the rice after it was well cooked.

definition: a boiling or being boiled.
example_en: The boiling of the milk overflowed from the side of the vessel.

definition: to engage in a physical struggle, pulling each other.
example_en: The children began pulling each other with the rope.

definition: a reckless, violent, brutal man; a ruffian.
example_en: That ruffian was frightening the people of the town.

definition: a boastful talk about deeds, abilities, etc., either one's own or those of someone close to one, esp. in a manner showing too much pride and satisfaction; brag.
example: ತನ್ನ ಸಾಹಸದ ಕತ್ಥನವನ್ನು ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He told the boastful tale of his exploits in front of everyone.

definition: at that moment.
example: ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಅವನು ಮನೆಗೆ ಓಡಿದನು.
example_en: As soon as he heard the news, he ran home.

definition: intense grief.
example_en: Her father's death caused her intense grief.

definition: invincible valour.
example: ಆ ವೀರನ ಅಜಿತಸಾಹಸವನ್ನು ಕವಿಗಳು ಹಾಡಿ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: Poets sang and praised that hero's invincible valour.

definition: a kind of epidemic disease.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಾವುಸ ರೋಗ ಹರಡಿ ಜನ ಸತ್ತರು.
example_en: The tāvusa epidemic spread in the village and people died.

definition: a bunch of flowers.
example_en: She wore a bunch of flowers in her hair.

definition: an artificial pond or water-tank.
example_en: There is an artificial water-tank outside the village.

definition: the state of being dry; parched condition; aridity.
example_en: Aridity came upon the land during summer.

definition: a woolen blanket.
example_en: In winter, the woollen blanket is used as a warm cover.

definition: red or brown colour.
example: ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಚುಂಚು ಬಣ್ಣ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಇಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.

definition: a being honoured.
example_en: The honour received by that teacher was rare.

definition: (sediment) to raise (in a stagnant water) from the bottom.
example_en: Due to the movement of the fish, sediment rose from the bottom of the pond.

definition: the act of causing loss of sensation by an anesthetic, hypnosis or acupuncture and limited to a specific area or involving a loss of consciousness.
example_en: Anesthesia was given to the patient before the surgery.

definition: Viṣṇu, whose couch is a seprent.
example_en: The devotees prayed to Vishnu, whose couch is a serpent.

definition: the fact or state of being associated or joined with; association.
example_en: An association came about between the two organisations.

definition: a kind of dish made using mutton.
example: ಔತಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈಮ ಎಂಬ ಮಾಂಸದ ಖಾದ್ಯ ಬಡಿಸಿದರು.

definition: to cause to beat, strike.
example_en: He struck the dog with a stick.

definition: a statement in excess of the truth; exaggeration or hyperbolical language; extravagant representation.

definition: a helping another or others with unselfish motive; altruism'.

definition: (one's heroic courage) to spring up.
example_en: When he saw the enemies, the hero's courage sprang up.

definition: (myst.) the cosmic power latent at the base of the physical system of human beings, in the form of microcosm which, when awakened by yogic methods, proceeds upward through different planes of consciousness, rendering each of them dynamic and make the individual possess, and be possessed by, the universal consciousness.
example_en: The yogi awakened the kundalini power through meditation.

definition: the act of ploughing.
example_en: The farmer began the ploughing early in the morning.

definition: the inner chamber of a house; a room or inner apartment.

example_en: The incision in surgery must be done carefully.

definition: a very large multitude.
example_en: A very large multitude gathered at the fair.

definition: the state or quality of not being straight; crookedness.

definition: to go or to carry on travelling.

definition: to lose freshness or strength; to wither; to wane; to fade.

definition: an eye that is looking ugly with rheum.

definition: to scatter things here and there; to strew in a disorderly manner.

definition: to yearn strongly for; to have strong desire for.
example_en: He was yearning strongly to go to his hometown.

definition: soil heaped around the foot of a tree or other plant.
example_en: They have heaped the soil well around the foot of the plant.

definition: an exposing of oneself to steam, to induce sweating, and for cleansing and refreshing; seam-bath.
example_en: After his illness he took a steam-bath.

definition: a person who habitually cheats.
example_en: People must be careful of the habitual cheat.

definition: an unborn young human being in its later stages, from about eighth week after conception (until birth); a foetus.

definition: touching the sky; very tall.

definition: the quality of being practicable; practicability.

definition: (pl.) the leaders of two or both the parties.

example_en: The leaders of both parties met together and reached an agreement.

definition: the climber Trichosanthes anguina of Cucurbitaceae family.

definition: a man who can be influenced by a slanderer.

definition: to bring (a person, a thing etc.) by dragging; to haul.
example_en: The soldiers hauled the injured man along.

definition: to remove salt from (esp. sea water); to desalt; to desalinate.
example_en: Sea water can be desalinated and drunk.

definition: flowing (as a liquid).
example: ಬಂಡೆಯ ಮೇಲಿಂದ ಪ್ರಸ್ರವ ಜಲ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಸುರಿಯಿತು.

definition: an acute infectious disease, esp. of children, caused by a virus inflammation of the gray matter of the spinal cord resulting in permanent deformities; poliomyelitis.
example_en: The polio vaccine is mandatory for all children.

definition: an analytical study.
example_en: A new meaning was found through the analytical study of the text.

definition: a doing with constant and careful attention and diligently; persistent application; assiduousness.
example_en: The work got finished easily because of his diligent, assiduous effort.

definition: the small dark part of the skin protuberated on a woman's breast through which the milk supplied to her child; the nipple.

definition: the large sized, deciduous tree Lagerstroemia lanceolata of Lythraceae family.

definition: the act or an instance of swinging or moving regularly back and forth; oscillation.

definition: that is broken; shattered.

definition: the act of using or the state of being used; use; utilisation.

definition: a distance approx. equal to five miles.

definition: a most respected person, esp. in the field of knowledge; any man deserving respect or reverence because of age, position, etc.

definition: (the face) to become pale, lusterless or distorted.

definition: to pour or cause to flow down continuously.
example_en: The cook poured the sambar down into the vessel.

definition: a kind of frilled garment of girls covering from waist to the ankles.
example: ಪುಟ್ಟ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಹೂವಿನ ಚಿತ್ರವಿರುವ ಲಂಗ ಧರಿಸಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The little girl wore a skirt with a floral pattern.

definition: the space above the earth; the region remote from the earth.
example_en: Birds fly in the region above the earth.

definition: a person who travels; a traveller.
example_en: That traveller wandered through distant towns.

definition: to fix the official signature, symbol as a mark of authenticity.
example_en: The officer affixed the official mark to the agreement letter.

definition: a man who weaves fabrics on a loom; a weaver.
example_en: The weaver family has been weaving cloth for generations.

definition: a member of a local government of a village.
example_en: The village council member spoke at the meeting.

definition: an acute inflammation of the meninges of the brain and spinal cord, caused by a specific organism, accompanied by fever and occasionally red spots on the skin; brain fever.
example: ಆ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಮೇಂದುಜ್ವರ ಬಂದು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: That child got meningitis and was admitted to the hospital.

definition: the goose berry tree Phyllanthus maderaspatensis of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: A goose berry tree grows on the hillside.

definition: the tree Ficus drupaceae (var. pubescens) ( = F. mysorensis) of Moraceae family; demon fig tree.
example_en: A demon fig tree has grown on the bank of the lake.

definition: a lid for closing the top of a cooking vessel.
example_en: She covered the cooking vessel by placing a lid on top.

definition: a narrow eye.
example_en: Her narrow eye is beautiful to look at.

definition: a sweet tone.
example_en: The singer's sweet tone captivated the listeners.

definition: to lie, be lying on the ground.
example_en: The wounded soldier lay on the ground on the battlefield.

definition: to pour without break.
example_en: Water was pouring without break in the canal.

definition: a severe, often fatal complication of malaria characterised by a rapid heart-beat and the passing of dark urine; black-water fever.
example: ಆ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಕಾಳಮೂತ್ರ ಬಂದು ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಗಂಭೀರವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That patient got black-water fever and his condition turned serious.

definition: in the respiratory tract of most land vertebrates, the tube extending from the larynx to the two bronchi; the windpipe; the trachea.
example_en: The surgeon took care not to injure the windpipe.

definition: a man who serves or attends.
example_en: The servant was faithfully attending to his master.

definition: a bracelet worn on the upper arm.
example_en: She had worn an armlet on her upper arm.

definition: having the colour of pure snow or milk; white.
example_en: That horse's colour was white.

definition: either of the two fleshy parts or folds forming the edges of the mouth and important in speech; the lip.
example_en: His lip was dry and cracked.
